title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts — Monthly Level Requirements
content:
Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts levels are evaluated on day 1 of each calendar month. To hold (or be promoted to) a level, the shopper must meet all three of that level's minimums; a figure of 0 means no requirement.

| Level | Completed batches in the 30 days before evaluation | Rating average | On-time completions in the 30 days before evaluation | Consecutive failed evaluations tolerated before a one-level demotion | Evaluation day of the month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 0 (no requirement) | 0 (no requirement) | 0% (no requirement) | 0 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper | 0 (no requirement) | 0 (no requirement) | 0% (no requirement) | 0 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 40 | 4.8 stars | 90% | 1 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 80 | 4.85 stars | 93% | 1 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 150 | 4.9 stars | 95% | 1 | 1 |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 250 | 4.95 stars | 97% | 2 | 1 |

## Entry to the upper levels

Full-Service Shopper Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond are entered only when the account shows at least that level's completed batches, at least its rating average and at least its on-time percentage.

## Worked readings (hypothetical figures)

| Hypothetical batches / average / on-time | Highest level whose three minimums are all met |
|---|---|
| 160 / 4.92 / 96% | Full-Service Shopper Platinum (Diamond needs 250 batches) |
| 90 / 4.95 / 99% | Full-Service Shopper Gold (Platinum needs 150 batches) |
| 300 / 4.88 / 98% | Full-Service Shopper Gold (Platinum needs a 4.9 average) |
| 45 / 4.85 / 89% | Full-Service Shopper (Silver needs 90% on time) |

Each minimum is met at the figure itself: 40 batches meet the Silver minimum of 40, and 39 do not.
